summary: Frontend-only testing of Vague B+C UX improvements. Validated: (1) Storefront dark mode toggle (light↔dark, localStorage dina_theme, document.documentElement.dark class), (2) Footer brand name 'Chez Dina' present and rendered next to logo image, (3) Console sidebar collapse to ~72px with localStorage dina_sidebar_collapsed=1 then expand back to 260px (=0), (4) Console sidebar resize via drag handle to 320px with localStorage dina_sidebar_width=320 persisted, (5) IconPicker component works (grid, search filter 'livraison', click 'truck' option updates trigger label to 'Livraison / Camion'), (6) SaveButton pattern on /console/parametres — all 8 tab testids present (identite-save, coordonnees-save, ventes-save, livraison-save, documents-save, notifications-save, securite-save, paiements-save), identite-save shows disabled during save and success toast 'Identité enregistrée · logo propagé partout', (7) apparence-save on /console/site works with toast 'Apparence enregistrée'. ALL 5 features from the request work. One architectural issue found: SiteAppearance.jsx (containing testids trust-icon-{idx} and Rassurance sub-tab) is imported in App.js but NEVER mounted on any route — only the SectionBuilder's sb-trust-icon-{idx} inside /console/site?tab=accueil is reachable. The review request referenced trust-icon-0 at /console/site?tab=apparence?Rassurance which does not exist in the current UI (apparence tab shows Logo/Palette/Typographie only). IconPicker was successfully validated via sb-trust-icon-0 instead.

issues: Guided tour modal overlay (role=dialog) intercepts clicks on the sidebar-collapse-toggle for first-time users. Had to force JS click or hide overlay in testing. Consider z-index adjustment or allowing sidebar interactions behind the tour.

action_items: SiteAppearance.jsx is dead code (imported in App.js but no <Route> uses it). Either (a) add a route for it and expose the Rassurance tab with trust-icon-{idx}, or (b) remove the orphaned import and update the review spec to reference sb-trust-icon-{idx} inside tab=accueil instead.
React hydration warning on Dashboard: <span> rendered inside <option> element (PeriodSelector line ~96). Causes a console error in production. Replace inner span with plain text.
GuidedTour overlay z-index blocks sidebar interactions; consider lower z-index or dismissible via Escape.
critical_code_review_comments: ConsoleLayout.jsx is 400+ lines and contains AiChat component inline — should be split into smaller focused modules (sidebar, header, AiChat).
SiteAppearance.jsx is imported but never rendered — orphan component, remove or wire up a route.
PeriodSelector renders <span> inside <option>, triggers React hydration error.

ConsoleLayout useEffect for mousemove/mouseup resize listeners attached globally with empty deps — OK, but startResize uses a ref so React never re-renders during drag (correct). Width upper cap 400 may be a bit low for ultra-wide users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 features validated; 1 testid spec discrepancy noted)

The only outstanding items are (a) decide what to do with the orphan SiteAppearance.jsx + its trust-icon-{idx} testids referenced in the review spec, (b) fix PeriodSelector's <span>-in-<option> hydration warning, and (c) adjust GuidedTour overlay so new users can still interact with the sidebar during the tour. All localStorage keys (dina_theme, dina_sidebar_collapsed, dina_sidebar_width) persist correctly.
